text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Marina Silva", "gist": "Brazilian Minister of Environment and Climate"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Jean-Noël Barrot", "gist": "French Minister for Digital Transformation and Telecommunications"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Davos", "gist": "Location of the meeting"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Brasile", "gist": "Brazil"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "governo brasiliano", "gist": "Brazilian government"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il Brasile mira a rafforzare il proprio ruolo a livello internazionale nella protezione del clima e a un orientamento più sostenibile per la propria economia.", "gist": "Brazil aims to strengthen its international role in climate protection and shift its economy towards sustainability."}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "una delle prossime conferenze mondiali sul clima si svolga nella regione della foresta pluviale", "gist": "one of the next global climate conferences is held in the rainforest region"}]}
